<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="第 1 页" id="NowGwD7MMgdFsqXP6OEg"> <mxGraphModel dx="4424" dy="1014" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 participant CPU as CPU(M)
 participant MEM as Mem control(S)
 participant DMAM as SIP DMA(M)
 participant DMAS as SIP DMA(S)

 rect rgb(240, 248, 255)
 note over CPU, DMAS: 1. CPU 配置 SIP 暫存器 (AXI Write)
 CPU->>DMAS: AWADDR, AWVALID (AW 通道)
 DMAS-->>CPU: AWREADY
 CPU->>DMAS: WDATA, WVALID, WLAST (W 通道)
 DMAS-->>CPU: WREADY
 DMAS-->>CPU: BVALID, BRESP = OKAY (B 通道)
 end

 rect rgb(255, 250, 240)
 note over DMAS: 2. SIP DMA 觸發啟動
 end

 rect rgb(240, 255, 240)
 note over MEM, DMAM: 3. DMA 搬移資料至 Memory (AXI Write)
 DMAM->>MEM: AWADDR, AWVALID (AW 通道)
 MEM-->>DMAM: AWREADY
 DMAM->>MEM: WDATA, WVALID, WLAST (W 通道)
 MEM-->>DMAM: WREADY
 MEM-->>DMAM: BVALID, BRESP (B 通道)
 end

 rect rgb(255, 240, 245)
 note over CPU, DMAS: 4. 中斷通報
 DMAS-->>CPU: IRQ (搬移完成中斷)
 end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
